name: The Raven: Legacy of a Master Thief

locations.note: Constable Zellner is already aboard the Orient Express guarding a ruby when a tunnel explosion stops it in the Swiss Alps.
The story continues from the Venice dock to the MS Lydia.
The Raven steals the single displayed ruby in the Cairo museum, and Zellner catches him and learns his identity.
Part 2 replays events from Adil's side at Zurich main station and on the Orient Express.

routes.name: Constable Zellner
routes.note: From the Orient Express in the Alps by ship to Cairo and back to Zurich.
